dialogues.en: I feel good and refreshed.
dialogues.text: I feel good and refreshed.

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「兄さん！　いつまで寝てる気ですか？」
dialogues.en: "Hi, niisan."
dialogues.text: "Hi, niisan."

dialogues.jp:
身体をゆさゆさ揺らされ、｛まぶた／瞼｝を開ける。充分な
睡眠をとれたのか、今日の瞼は軽かった。
dialogues.en: Well, maybe it's about time to get up anyway.
dialogues.text: Well, maybe it's about time to get up anyway.

dialogues.jp: 「おはよう」
すっきりとした、素晴らしい目覚めだ。
dialogues.en: Giving a big yawn, I stretch my arms in the air.
dialogues.text: Giving a big yawn, I stretch my arms in the air.

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「｛・・・・・／こんにちは｝、兄さん」
dialogues.en:
"Please get up earlier. You seem at least to be making an
effort this time, though."
dialogues.text:
"Please get up earlier. You seem at least to be making an
effort this time, though."

dialogues.en: "Effort?"
dialogues.text: "Effort?"

dialogues.jp: まぁ、そんぐらいの時間なのだろう。
dialogues.en: The word is completely unrelated to me.
dialogues.text: The word is completely unrelated to me.

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「もっと早くに起きてよね。まあ今回は努力は
　してたみたいですけど」
dialogues.en: "I heard your alarm clock going off a little while ago."
dialogues.text: "I heard your alarm clock going off a little while ago."

dialogues.jp: それは、俺にとってあまりに無縁な言葉だ。
dialogues.en: Alarm clock?
dialogues.text: Alarm clock?

dialogues.jp: 目覚まし？
dialogues.en: Oh yeah... maybe I heard it going off a short time ago.
dialogues.text: Oh yeah... maybe I heard it going off a short time ago.

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「とにかく、もう起きてくださいね」
dialogues.en: "Anyway, it's time to get up, okay?"
dialogues.text: "Anyway, it's time to get up, okay?"

dialogues.jp:
俺にクギだけさすと、音夢はくるりと後ろを向
いて部屋から出て行く。
dialogues.en: Giving me a warning, Nemu turned and got out of my room.
dialogues.text: Giving me a warning, Nemu turned and got out of my room.

dialogues.jp:
（なんで、目覚ましなんてセットしたんだろ
　う……）
dialogues.en: (Why did I set the alarm......?)
dialogues.text: (Why did I set the alarm......?)

dialogues.jp: 「そうだった……」
dialogues.en: "Oh, now I remember......"
dialogues.text: "Oh, now I remember......"

dialogues.jp: 忘れてた。
dialogues.en: Shit, I forgot about that.
dialogues.text: Shit, I forgot about that.

dialogues.jp: いま、何時だ？
dialogues.en: What time is it?
dialogues.text: What time is it?

dialogues.jp: 目覚ましの文字盤に目を向け、時刻を確認する。
dialogues.en: I look at the clock face to check the time.
dialogues.text: I look at the clock face to check the time.

dialogues.jp: 丁度、約束の時間だ。
dialogues.en: It's time for the appointment.
dialogues.text: It's time for the appointment.

dialogues.jp:
もはや鉄拳制裁は決定。後はダメージに違いが
あるだけだ。
dialogues.en:
I'm gonna get shot at for sure. The only question is how
much damage I'll take.
dialogues.text:
I'm gonna get shot at for sure. The only question is how
much damage I'll take.

dialogues.jp: 「まあ、身支度だけ整えていくか」
dialogues.en: "Well, I should get dressed at least."
dialogues.text: "Well, I should get dressed at least."

dialogues.jp:
昼飯は、映画観ながら菓子でもつまめばいいだ
ろう。
dialogues.en:
I can skip eating, because I can eat some snacks while
watching a movie.
dialogues.text:
I can skip eating, because I can eat some snacks while
watching a movie.

dialogues.jp: ベッドから起き上がり、適当な私服に着替える。
dialogues.en: I pick myself up from my bed and put on some plain clothes.
dialogues.text: I pick myself up from my bed and put on some plain clothes.

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「あれ、どこか出かけるの？」
dialogues.en: "Are you going somewhere?"
dialogues.text: "Are you going somewhere?"

dialogues.jp:
階段を下り、そのまま玄関に直行した俺に、音
夢が居間から顔を覗かせる。
dialogues.en:
I make it down the steps and all the way to the front door,
before Nemu peeps at me from the living room.
dialogues.text:
I make it down the steps and all the way to the front door,
before Nemu peeps at me from the living room.

dialogues.jp: 「デートだ」
dialogues.en: "I have a date."
dialogues.text: "I have a date."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.en: "What!?"
dialogues.text: "What!?"

dialogues.jp: 音夢の絶句する声に送られ、外にでる。
dialogues.en:
Leaving Nemu and her exclamation behind, I step outside the
front door.
dialogues.text:
Leaving Nemu and her exclamation behind, I step outside the
front door.

dialogues.jp: 「いい天気だな……」
dialogues.en: "Nice weather......"
dialogues.text: "Nice weather......"

dialogues.jp: さすがに走ると汗をかきそうだ。
dialogues.en: I may sweat if I run.
dialogues.text: I may sweat if I run.

dialogues.jp: 「歩いていくか」
dialogues.en: "I guess I should walk."
dialogues.text: "I guess I should walk."

dialogues.jp: 早歩きなら、そこそこ時間も短縮できるだろう。
dialogues.en: If I walk fast, I may be able to save some time.
dialogues.text: If I walk fast, I may be able to save some time.

dialogues.jp:
心地良い風を感じながら、商店街への道を歩い
ていく。
dialogues.en:
A pleasant wind on my face, I go down the path to the
shopping street.
dialogues.text:
A pleasant wind on my face, I go down the path to the
shopping street.

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.en: "You're late!!"
dialogues.text: "You're late!!"

dialogues.jp:
当然のごとく、商店街の入口には、阿修羅も裸
足で逃げ出しそうな眞子が待ち構えていた。
dialogues.en:
As expected, Mako was waiting for me at the entrance of the
high street, hopping mad.
dialogues.text:
As expected, Mako was waiting for me at the entrance of the
high street, hopping mad.

dialogues.jp: 「ごめん、待った？」
dialogues.en: "Sorry, were you waiting long?"
dialogues.text: "Sorry, were you waiting long?"

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp:
「『待った？』じゃないっ。何時間待たせるつ
　もり！？」
dialogues.en:
"'Waiting long?' How dare you! How many hours were you
trying to keep me waiting for?"
dialogues.text:
"'Waiting long?' How dare you! How many hours were you
trying to keep me waiting for?"

dialogues.jp:
今にも切れのいいストレートが飛んできそうな
勢いで眞子が迫ってくる。
dialogues.en: Mako walks up to me, seeming about to hit me.
dialogues.text: Mako walks up to me, seeming about to hit me.

dialogues.jp:
「こらこら。こういう時は『ううん、わたしも
　今来たところだから』だろ？」
dialogues.en:
"Hey now. In a situation like this, you're supposed to say
'It's all right because I just got here myself', right?"
dialogues.text:
"Hey now. In a situation like this, you're supposed to say
'It's all right because I just got here myself', right?"

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.en: "Ugh!?"
dialogues.text: "Ugh!?"

dialogues.jp:
恋人のフリを逆手にとった俺の言葉に、眞子の
拳が止まる。
dialogues.en:
Hearing my words that sound like I'm her boyfriend, Mako
stops moving her fist.
dialogues.text:
Hearing my words that sound like I'm her boyfriend, Mako
stops moving her fist.

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp: 「……分かったわよ」
dialogues.en: "......Okay. I'll let it slide this time."
dialogues.text: "......Okay. I'll let it slide this time."

dialogues.jp:
眞子の拳は、くりだされることなく下におろさ
れた。
dialogues.en:
Since she won't be able to use her fist to pummel me, Mako
lets her hand drop to her side.
dialogues.text:
Since she won't be able to use her fist to pummel me, Mako
lets her hand drop to her side.

dialogues.jp: 「セリフは？」
dialogues.en: "So what are you supposed to say?"
dialogues.text: "So what are you supposed to say?"

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp: 「口が裂けても言わない」
dialogues.en: "I would never say that."
dialogues.text: "I would never say that."

dialogues.jp: ――残念。
dialogues.en: ---- Too bad.
dialogues.text: ---- Too bad.

dialogues.jp: 「とりあえず映画館に行こうぜ」
dialogues.en: "Anyway, let's go to the movie theater."
dialogues.text: "Anyway, let's go to the movie theater."

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp: 「ちょっと待ってよ」
dialogues.en: "Hey, wait!"
dialogues.text: "Hey, wait!"

dialogues.jp:
歩き始めた俺の後ろを追ってきて、眞子が横に
並ぶ。
dialogues.en:
I'd already started to walk, but Mako catches me up and
walks alongside me.
dialogues.text:
I'd already started to walk, but Mako catches me up and
walks alongside me.

dialogues.jp: 少しだけ、普段より間をつめて歩いている。
dialogues.en: We are walking slightly closer to each other than usual.
dialogues.text: We are walking slightly closer to each other than usual.

dialogues.jp:
（やっぱ他人から見たら、カップルに見えるの
　かな……？）
dialogues.en:
(I wonder if we look like a couple in the eyes of
strangers.)
dialogues.text:
(I wonder if we look like a couple in the eyes of
strangers.)

dialogues.jp: そのまま、映画館に向かう。
dialogues.en: We go right on to the movie theater.
dialogues.text: We go right on to the movie theater.

dialogues.jp: 「もう始まってるな」
dialogues.en: "It seems like the movie's already started."
dialogues.text: "It seems like the movie's already started."

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp: 「あんたが遅れて来るからでしょうが」
dialogues.en: "Because you showed up so late."
dialogues.text: "Because you showed up so late."

dialogues.jp: 目的の映画は、見事に始まっていた。
dialogues.en: The movie we were planning to watch has already begun.
dialogues.text: The movie we were planning to watch has already begun.

dialogues.jp: 「次の上映まで結構時間があるな……」
dialogues.en: "The next show won't start for a long time..."
dialogues.text: "The next show won't start for a long time..."

dialogues.jp: さすがに待つのはしんどい。
dialogues.en: It's not easy to wait.
dialogues.text: It's not easy to wait.

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp: 「どうすんのよ」
dialogues.en: "Now what?"
dialogues.text: "Now what?"

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp: 「しゃあないから、他のを観ようぜ」
dialogues.en: "No choice, let's watch another one."
dialogues.text: "No choice, let's watch another one."

dialogues.jp: 幸い、１０分後に始まるやつがある。
dialogues.en: Fortunately, there is one that will start in 10 minutes.
dialogues.text: Fortunately, there is one that will start in 10 minutes.

dialogues.jp: 「あれにしよう」
dialogues.en: "Okay, we can watch that one."
dialogues.text: "Okay, we can watch that one."

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp: 「どれ？」
dialogues.en: "Which one?"
dialogues.text: "Which one?"

dialogues.jp: 眞子の視線が、俺の視線を追う。
dialogues.en: Mako's eyes follow my gaze.
dialogues.text: Mako's eyes follow my gaze.

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.en: "What!?"
dialogues.text: "What!?"

dialogues.jp:
俺の視線に追いついた眞子が、ビックリした声
を漏らす。
dialogues.en: When she sees what I was looking at, Mako gasps in surprise.
dialogues.text: When she sees what I was looking at, Mako gasps in surprise.

dialogues.jp:
そこには、今話題のホラー映画の看板がかかっ
ていた。
dialogues.en:
There's an advertising sign for the current hot horror
movie.
dialogues.text:
There's an advertising sign for the current hot horror
movie.

dialogues.jp: 「ほら、行こうぜ。あんま時間ないし」
dialogues.en: "Let's go. We don't have much time left."
dialogues.text: "Let's go. We don't have much time left."

dialogues.jp:
今からだと、あまりいい席は残ってないだろう
けど、まあ、観れないよりはマシだ。
dialogues.en:
It may be too late to find good seats, but it's still better
than nothing.
dialogues.text:
It may be too late to find good seats, but it's still better
than nothing.

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp: 「ちょ、ちょっと待った」
dialogues.en: "H-hold on."
dialogues.text: "H-hold on."

dialogues.jp:
１歩踏み出した俺の肩を掴んで、眞子が呼び止
める。
dialogues.en: Grabbing me by my shoulder, Mako stops me as I step away.
dialogues.text: Grabbing me by my shoulder, Mako stops me as I step away.

dialogues.jp: 「なんだ？」
dialogues.en: "What?"
dialogues.text: "What?"

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp:
「やっぱさ、こっちを観ようよ。どっかで時間
　潰して」
dialogues.en:
"I still wanna watch this one. We can fill the time
somewhere."
dialogues.text:
"I still wanna watch this one. We can fill the time
somewhere."

dialogues.jp: 眞子が当初の映画の看板を指差す。
dialogues.en:
Mako points at the sign for the movie we planned to watch
originally.
dialogues.text:
Mako points at the sign for the movie we planned to watch
originally.

dialogues.jp: 「だって４時間後だぞ。そんなに待てないだろ」
dialogues.en: "But it's gonna start in 4 hours. Who can wait that long?"
dialogues.text: "But it's gonna start in 4 hours. Who can wait that long?"

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp:
「で、でもやっぱり今日はこの映画を観に来た
　んだし……」
dialogues.en: "B-But we came here to watch this movie......"
dialogues.text: "B-But we came here to watch this movie......"

dialogues.jp: 落ち着きなく、身体をそわそわさせている。
dialogues.en: She gets into a flap.
dialogues.text: She gets into a flap.

dialogues.jp: まさかとは思うが……。
dialogues.en: I don't believe it but...
dialogues.text: I don't believe it but...

dialogues.jp: 「もしかして怖いのか？」
dialogues.en: "Are you scared?"
dialogues.text: "Are you scared?"

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp: 「ばっ……そんな訳ないじゃない」
dialogues.en: "No... Hell no."
dialogues.text: "No... Hell no."

dialogues.jp:
見え見えの虚勢……やっぱそうなのか。ホラー
映画が怖いとかって、某ゲームのヒロインくら
いかと思ったが。
dialogues.en:
That's such a bluff... It figures. But I didn't think that
anyone other than a main heroine in a game could be scared
of horror movies.
dialogues.text:
That's such a bluff... It figures. But I didn't think that
anyone other than a main heroine in a game could be scared
of horror movies.

dialogues.jp: （こいつは使える！）
dialogues.en: (This is useful!)
dialogues.text: (This is useful!)

dialogues.jp: ここで弱みを握れば、今後、優位にたてるかも。
dialogues.en:
If I can make use of her weak point, I may be able to gain
an advantage over her in future.
dialogues.text:
If I can make use of her weak point, I may be able to gain
an advantage over her in future.

dialogues.jp:
考え方がちと危ないが、まあ気にしない気にし
ない。
dialogues.en: This way of thinking is a little risky, but who cares?
dialogues.text: This way of thinking is a little risky, but who cares?

dialogues.jp:
「じゃあ行こうぜ♪　早くしないとこいつまで
　始まっちまう」
dialogues.en: "Okay then, let's go. Hurry up, the movie is gonna start."
dialogues.text: "Okay then, let's go. Hurry up, the movie is gonna start."

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp: 「あっ、ちょっと待ちなさいよ」
dialogues.en: "Uh, hey, wait."
dialogues.text: "Uh, hey, wait."

dialogues.jp: 慌てる眞子を無視して、入口に向かう。
dialogues.en:
Ignoring the flustered Mako, I start walking toward the
entrance.
dialogues.text:
Ignoring the flustered Mako, I start walking toward the
entrance.

dialogues.jp:
諦めたように｛うめ／呻｝きながら、重い足取りで眞子が
ついてきた。
dialogues.en:
Groaning with a resigned look, Mako follows me with a heavy
gait.
dialogues.text:
Groaning with a resigned look, Mako follows me with a heavy
gait.

dialogues.jp:
売店でジュース２本とポップコーンを買って、
席に着く。
dialogues.en:
We buy popcorn and two bottles of juice at the concession
stand, and take our seats.
dialogues.text:
We buy popcorn and two bottles of juice at the concession
stand, and take our seats.

dialogues.jp:
スクリーンに目を向け、ポップコーンを口に運
びつつ、眞子の様子を窺う。
dialogues.en:
Looking at the screen and bringing popcorn to my mouth, I
check out how Mako is doing.
dialogues.text:
Looking at the screen and bringing popcorn to my mouth, I
check out how Mako is doing.

dialogues.jp:
眞子はスクリーンに視線を固定したまま、カチ
カチに固まっていた。
dialogues.en: Mako's rigid, with her eyes fixed on the screen.
dialogues.text: Mako's rigid, with her eyes fixed on the screen.

dialogues.jp:
ジュースの｛ふた／蓋｝を開けずに両手で持ち、ぎゅっと
握りしめている。中身が入っているのに、へこ
ませてしまいそうな勢いだ。
dialogues.en:
She's holding the juice tight with both hands without
opening the cap. It has juice in it, but it looks like she's
gonna squish it.
dialogues.text:
She's holding the juice tight with both hands without
opening the cap. It has juice in it, but it looks like she's
gonna squish it.

dialogues.jp: （――て言うか、もう、へこんでるし）
dialogues.en: (--Ah, it's actually squashed.)
dialogues.text: (--Ah, it's actually squashed.)

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp: 「ひっ！」
dialogues.en: "Eep!"
dialogues.text: "Eep!"

dialogues.jp:
ポイントポイントで、必ず小さく悲鳴をあげる。
その瞬きひとつしない目は、どんな小さな恐怖
も見逃さない。
dialogues.en:
She gives a small scream every time she sees a scary scene.
Watching the movie unblinkingly, she never misses a scary
part.
dialogues.text:
She gives a small scream every time she sees a scary scene.
Watching the movie unblinkingly, she never misses a scary
part.

dialogues.jp:
（なんか、こうして見ていると、女の子にしか
　見えないなぁ）
dialogues.en: (When I look at her this way, she just looks like a girl.)
dialogues.text: (When I look at her this way, she just looks like a girl.)

dialogues.jp:
いや、生物学的にも法律的にも正真正銘“女”
なのだが。
dialogues.en: Well, she is biologically and legally a complete 'girl'.
dialogues.text: Well, she is biologically and legally a complete 'girl'.

dialogues.jp:
普段、気の強いところを見ている分、余計に女
の子らしく感じてしまう。
dialogues.en:
But because I normally see her strong character, now it's
particularly noticeable how she's girlish.
dialogues.text:
But because I normally see her strong character, now it's
particularly noticeable how she's girlish.

dialogues.jp: （なんか映画なんかどうでもいいかな……）
dialogues.en: (I don't feel like watching the movie......)
dialogues.text: (I don't feel like watching the movie......)

dialogues.jp: （手とか握ったら喜ぶのかな……）
dialogues.en: (Would she like it if I held her hand......?)
dialogues.text: (Would she like it if I held her hand......?)

dialogues.jp: 俺は暗闇のなか、ずっと眞子のほうを見ていた。
dialogues.en: I've been looking at Mako in the dark...
dialogues.text: I've been looking at Mako in the dark...

dialogues.jp: 「うむ。なかなか面白かったな」
dialogues.en: "Hmm. Pretty good, wasn't it?"
dialogues.text: "Hmm. Pretty good, wasn't it?"

dialogues.jp:
映画の内容なんて全然覚えてないけど、普段見
せない眞子の反応を見てるだけで、十分有意義
だったと納得する。
dialogues.en:
I don't remember the content of the movie at all, but I had
a good time because I could watch reactions that I don't
usually see from Mako.
dialogues.text:
I don't remember the content of the movie at all, but I had
a good time because I could watch reactions that I don't
usually see from Mako.

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp: 「……そうね」

眞子のほうは、疲労こんぱいとした表情で俺の
隣を歩いていた。
dialogues.en: Mako's walking next to me in a state of exhaustion.
dialogues.text: Mako's walking next to me in a state of exhaustion.

dialogues.jp: ちょっと、罪悪感を感じる。
dialogues.en: I feel a little guilty.
dialogues.text: I feel a little guilty.

dialogues.jp: 「どっか寄ってくか？」
dialogues.en: "Do you wanna stop by somewhere?"
dialogues.text: "Do you wanna stop by somewhere?"

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp: 「じゃあ送ってやるよ」
dialogues.en: "I'll take you home then."
dialogues.text: "I'll take you home then."

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.en: "Thanks......"
dialogues.text: "Thanks......"

dialogues.jp:
ふらつく身体を支えるように、俺に寄りかかっ
てくる。
dialogues.en: She leans on me as if to support herself.
dialogues.text: She leans on me as if to support herself.

dialogues.jp:
意外に柔らかい身体の感触に、驚く。女の子の
身体のぬくもり――。
dialogues.en:
I'm surprised at her skin, which is unexpectedly soft. The
warmth of a girl's body ----
dialogues.text:
I'm surprised at her skin, which is unexpectedly soft. The
warmth of a girl's body ----

dialogues.jp: なんだか心臓の鼓動が高鳴り、息苦しい。
dialogues.en: I feel my heartbeat quicken, and it's hard to breathe.
dialogues.text: I feel my heartbeat quicken, and it's hard to breathe.

dialogues.jp: ――かったりいぞ。
dialogues.en: ---- It's not looking good.
dialogues.text: ---- It's not looking good.

dialogues.jp:
心の動揺を誤魔化すように頭の中で念じながら、
眞子の家に向かった。
dialogues.en: I head for Mako's house, hoping to defuse my agitation.
dialogues.text: I head for Mako's house, hoping to defuse my agitation.

dialogues.jp: これは｛・・／フリ｝だ。
dialogues.en: This is 'pretense'.
dialogues.text: This is 'pretense'.

dialogues.jp: 分かっているだろうな、俺――。
dialogues.en: What a pain...
dialogues.text: What a pain...

dialogues.jp: ◆ホラーは苦手◆

眞子と映画の約束。起きたのは待ち合わせの時
間だった……。

見るはずだった映画は始まっていたので、取り
あえず時間の合うホラー映画を見ることに。
dialogues.en: "Hey, niisan! How long are you going to sleep?"
dialogues.text: "Hey, niisan! How long are you going to sleep?"

dialogues.jp:
強がってはいたものの、眞子はめちゃくちゃホ
ラー映画が苦手なようだ。

なんだかんだ言っても、やっぱり女の子だよ
なぁ……。
dialogues.en:
Shaken awake, I open my eyes. Maybe because I got plenty of
sleep, I can easily open my eyes today.
dialogues.text:
Shaken awake, I open my eyes. Maybe because I got plenty of
sleep, I can easily open my eyes today.

dialogues.jp: そんな眞子がなんだか可愛く思えた。
dialogues.en: "Good morning."
dialogues.text: "Good morning."
